Hello ! I am utybo, the creator of CoffeeVoat. I will answer some questions here.

What is CoffeeVoat ?

CoffeeVoat is a small project that aims to provide a full and easy-to-use port of Voat's Beta API in Java. This means that you will be able to easily use Voat's power in your Java and Android applications thanks to CoffeeVoat!

Why CoffeeVoat ?

  • Fully Object-Oriented approach : CoffeeVoat works on an Object Oriented model. This means that a submission is an object, a comment is an object, an user is an object...

  • Easy to use : You can do everything with methods. Delete, create, edit submissions, reply to comments... These actions only require one call.

  • Only one third party library required : CoffeeVoat only need one third party library to be able to work called json, which is the official JSON implementation in Java.

Final note.

CoffeeVoat is currently in development. It will be open-sourced as soon as possible (I am not on my own computer right now.)

If you have any question, create a submission on this subverse !
